messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline. Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in an alternate universe where the industrial revolution never happened

message.content:
Before, no factory coughed into dawn, and rivers carried the first cities on slow barges, Before
Then, windmills and canals shaped trade, and guilds of weavers, glassblowers, and cartographers built their empires, Then
When, maps bloomed in quiet observatories, and sailing ships crossed oceans while clocks ticked in monastery halls, When
Now, the world rests beneath orchard roofs, its future grown from seed, soil, and patient hands, Now
